title: job-scout
description: job-scout career control plane: pipeline funnel, LLM usage through an OpenAI-compatible gateway, worker queue, API/MCP/chat/browser, Node runtime, k8s and JSON logs. Metrics: job_scout_* from /metrics (port 9464) scraped by Alloy via k8s.grafana.com annotations. Source: github.com/giovannirco/job-scout deploy/helm/job-scout/dashboards/job-scout.json

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Running build (job_scout_build_info).

panels.title: Hot pipeline
panels.description: Positions in review, materials, applied, interview or offer.

panels.title: Untriaged
panels.description: Non-archived positions the LLM has not scored yet.

panels.title: Inbox pending
panels.description: Autopilot approvals waiting for the operator.

panels.title: Oldest queued
panels.description: Age of the oldest due job still waiting. Growing = worker starved or down.

panels.title: Boards errored / stale
panels.description: Enabled boards whose last scan failed, plus boards not scanned in 2 days.

panels.title: LLM calls today
panels.description: UTC day, all operations (DB truth).

panels.title: Call budget used
panels.description: 0 when no daily call budget is configured (Settings > Autopilot).

panels.title: Gate refusals (1h)
panels.description: disabled / no_model / cap_reached / budget_reached / not_configured.

panels.title: Scrape DB refresh
panels.description: Time the API spent refreshing DB-truth gauges on the last scrape.

panels.title: Funnel (non-archived)
panels.description: Positions by pipeline status.

panels.title: Discovery, last 24h (by lane)
panels.description: Rolling 24h count of discovery rows by gate lane.

panels.title: Today by operation / model
panels.description: Left: DB truth for the UTC day. Right: process counters over the last 24h (resets on restart) — the only place the model shows up.

panels.title: Jobs by outcome
panels.description: ok / failed / retry (transient LLM error) / parked (cap or budget hit).

panels.title: Queue by status
panels.description: Rows in the jobs table (retention prunes finished rows).

panels.title: Scheduler ticks
panels.description: In-process ticks (requeue-stale always; discovery/watch/retention only when WORKER_SCHEDULER=1).

panels.title: Scan listings by outcome
panels.description: seen → gate_pass / gate_fail → created / updated; closed = vanished from the board.

panels.title: Autopilot actions
panels.description: What each hook decided to do (noop hidden).

panels.title: MCP tool calls
panels.description: career-ops sync, Cursor/Grok agents.

panels.title: Edge RED — req/s by route (Beyla eBPF)
panels.description: Kernel-side view of the api pod from the cluster-wide Beyla DaemonSet; includes static assets and health probes.

panels.title: CronJobs — time since last success
panels.description: discovery every 30m, watch every 2h, retention daily.

panels.title: Warnings and errors
panels.description: Every warn/error JSON line from api, worker and cron pods.
